description: Violates the no-op gate nuance (verification-contract.md §4.4; lifecycle-model.md §5.1): gates.emptyDeclarationKeepsGate is declared false — the declaration asserts that declaring zero checks opens the gate. Declaring no content does not open the gate: the gate position remains and the gate remains — a no-op gate, not an open door. The const-true declaration rejects 'false'.
